field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: declares the three mandated GGUF identities so the run cannot drift to tiny or non-GGUF models.
field_principles.candidate_domain_receipts: proves the bounded answer domain is complete and the exact candidate is present.
field_principles.candidate_omission_count: blocks missing exact candidates from a finite-choice receipt.
field_principles.control_manifest: freezes exact controls, polarity, category, prompt, and expected answer before model scores.
field_principles.cuda_device_receipts: preserves visible GPU, driver, free VRAM, and worker return evidence.
field_principles.cuda_offload_authenticated: per-model bare gate for positive offload plus memory delta.
field_principles.cuda_offload_authenticated_score: mechanical flagship CUDA scalar; 1.0 only when Qwen and Gemma31 both authenticate.
field_principles.external_scorer_used: bare false prevents judges or external scorers from deciding rows.
field_principles.field_principles: every gate field states the evidence boundary it protects.
field_principles.freeform_generation_used: bare false preserves the no-free-form boundary.
field_principles.gguf_filenames: names the concrete GGUF file used by llama.cpp.
field_principles.gpu_memory_receipts: before/during/after memory deltas authenticate non-CPU execution.
field_principles.grammar_runtime_used: bare false preserves the no-grammar-runtime boundary.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal status starts complete: or blocked: and names the qualification boundary.
field_principles.inference_substrate: declares local llama.cpp CUDA GGUF finite-choice scoring.
field_principles.label_collision_count: blocks tokenizer label collisions from ambiguous scoring.
field_principles.label_permutation_hashes: binds sealed random candidate-to-label mappings without leaking the answer.
field_principles.label_token_receipts: proves every visible label is one unique embedded-tokenizer token per model.
field_principles.llama_cpp_build_info: records CUDA build support instead of assuming GPU offload.
field_principles.llama_cpp_version: pins the Python llama.cpp runtime version.
field_principles.model_hashes: hashes weight bytes so model provenance cannot float.
field_principles.n_gpu_layers_offloaded: separates positive GPU layer offload from requested offload.
field_principles.non_finite_score_count: blocks NaN or infinity from selecting proposals.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: records cache, hash, tokenizer, CUDA, free-VRAM, and llama.cpp checks before qualification.
field_principles.proposal_channel_ready_score: strict channel-readiness scalar, not an accuracy metric.
field_principles.qualified_flagship_model_count: counts Qwen and Gemma31 qualification for the flagship gate.
field_principles.qualified_model_ids: names models whose score-vector and CUDA receipts are complete.
field_principles.quantizations: records observed quantization from the filename and receipt.
field_principles.random_seeds: records deterministic control and label-permutation seeds.
field_principles.receipt_failure_count: single mechanical blocker count for any provenance, domain, score, or validator failure.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: hashes artifact fields and score-vector commitment.
field_principles.resolved_model_receipts: binds each model id to an immutable local GGUF path and presence receipt.
field_principles.score_vector_manifest_path: points to full per-model/control label-score rows.
field_principles.token_scores_are_semantic_authority: bare false keeps logits as proposal scores only.
field_principles.validator_versions: versions primary, independent, and enumeration validators.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: bare true records that exact validators, not model scores, decide truth.
